Why you pay for the bank's insurance: PMI, explained simply.

Put less than 20% down on a conventional loan and you pay private mortgage insurance. It protects the lender, not you: with a small down payment the lender has more on the line if you stop paying.

Who chooses it: house hackers, and investors keeping cash for repairs or the next deal.

Count it in your monthly payment. It comes off around 20% equity. dealcaddie.ai

Why you pay for the bank's insurance: PMI, explained simply.

With less than 20% down on a conventional loan, borrowers pay private mortgage insurance. It protects the lender, not the borrower, because a small down payment leaves the lender with more on the line.

Who chooses it: house hackers buying with a small down payment, and investors keeping cash for repairs or the next deal.

Count it in the monthly payment when you underwrite a deal; leaving it out makes a deal look better than it is. You can request cancellation at 20% equity (based on original value), and it ends automatically at 22%. FHA mortgage insurance has different rules.

We read the green. You take the shot. dealcaddie.ai
